services.name: 5 × 7: Small Works Community Exhibit
services.desc: The Garrett County Arts Council invites the community to help fill the Special Exhibit Gallery with artwork created by the people of Garrett County. Inspired by the size of a greeting card, every piece in this exhibit will fit inside a 5×7 frame. GCAC will provide matching frames for the exhibit. Artists and creatives are invited to provide the work that goes inside them. Participation is open to all ages, experience levels, and creative styles. Artists do not need to be juried into The Gallery Shop to participate.
